results.csv.grain: one row per workload/system/space, latest attempt and selected successful training retry
results.csv.mean_iteration_s: Mean of max-over-ranks CUDA-synchronized step duration, steps 6..10. Batch preparation, forward/backward, optimizer and zero_grad included; post-step logging excluded.
results.csv.peak_allocated_bytes: Peak live Torch allocator bytes over eight ranks.
results.csv.peak_reserved_bytes: Peak reserved Torch allocator bytes over eight ranks; includes cache.
results.csv.peak_nvml_mib: Maximum of one-second whole-device memory samples; includes CUDA/NCCL context and allocator cache; sampling may miss transients.
results.csv.kv_heads: Actual selected attention KV head count. Full Devastator may change it; no claim of model quality equivalence.
results.csv.search_e2e_seconds: Primary fair-comparison metric: all workflow time from driver launch through selected config preparation. Excludes pre-collected communication and selected training. Read search_timing_method for original clock vs historical reconstruction.
results.csv.measured_stage_sum_s: Diagnostic stage subtotal only; excludes some wrapper preparation overhead and must not be used as total search cost.
results.csv.search_cumulative_e2e_seconds: Sum of E2E search time across all formal attempts for this case/system/space, including failed attempts. Null if any attempt timing is missing or still running. Excludes training retries and standalone diagnostic replays.
results.csv.search_attempts_recorded_seconds: Partial sum of recorded formal attempt timing; consult completeness flag.
results.csv.search_attempts_timing_complete: True only when every formal attempt has search E2E timing.
results.csv.search_attempt_count: Number of formal workflow attempts; excludes training-only retries.
results.csv.oom_*_gib: Original selected-training CUDA OOM exception memory figures, rounded GiB, including allocated, reserved-unallocated, free, requested and total. Historical OOM remains even if separate allocator diagnostic succeeds.
results.csv.oom_attribution: Verified causal classification from separate allocator-only replay. memory_management means unchanged selected workload passed ten steps after allocator setting change; formal original OOM status remains retained.

candidates.csv.grain: Devastator evaluated or rejected structural+strategy candidate, or Galvatron native search task
candidates.csv.predicted_cost: Read predicted_cost_unit; Devastator native microseconds, Galvatron seconds. Empty means not evaluated/infeasible, never replace by zero.
candidates.csv.memory_mib: Galvatron predicted memory by pipeline stage, not measured NVML memory.
candidates.csv.predicted_peak_bytes: Native Devastator rejected-candidate memory; absent for feasible candidates in original collector.

profile_accounting.csv.grain: Native Devastator profile counters/timings or Galvatron Profile launch
profile_accounting.csv.warning: Internal timings overlap; do not add all *_seconds fields. Use results.csv search_e2e_seconds for the full search cost.

steps.csv: Selected completed training, per-iteration max over ranks; measured flag marks 6..10.
rank_steps.csv: Per-rank raw step observations; loss can be null on pipeline ranks without loss.
attempts.csv: All main attempts and training retries, including failed integration runs.
completion_audit.json: Evidence gates for completed successful rows; incomplete/failed rows require investigation or explicit evidence-based terminal failure classification.

paired_results.csv.grain: Eight cases by two spaces; one row per paired system comparison. Missing measurements remain empty.
paired_results.csv.devastator_training_speedup_vs_galvatron: Galvatron measured step time divided by Devastator measured step time, only when both trainings completed. Greater than one favors Devastator.
paired_results.csv.galvatron_over_devastator_search_time: Galvatron end-to-end search time divided by Devastator end-to-end search time. Communication calibration excluded on both sides.
paired_results.csv.same_kv_heads: False means selected attention structures differ; a throughput ratio is not evidence of equal model quality.
paired_results.csv.galvatron_over_devastator_cumulative_sea: Ratio of cumulative search E2E time including failed formal attempts, when both trainings completed and all attempt timings are available.

terminal_result_audit.json: Verified native no-feasible and selected-training CUDA OOM outcomes; distinct from successful training. Verifies original evidence, does not infer all candidates physically infeasible.
common_phase_audit.json: Eight per-model common-space paired outcome audits: actual candidate equality, latest workflow and training-retry outcome, and successful-training or native-no-candidate evidence. Does not imply full-space completion.

galvatron_selected_layers.csv.grain: One row per layer of the latest selected Galvatron configuration, with source configuration SHA256 and outcome status. Configured layout, not measured execution evidence.
galvatron_selected_layers.csv.pipeline_stage_index: Zero-based pipeline stage index from native pp_division.
galvatron_selected_layers.csv.ulysses: Independent native use_sp sequence parallel degree; distinct from tensor-parallel sequence_parallel. TP and Ulysses are mutually exclusive here.
galvatron_selected_layers.csv.implied_micro_batch_size: global_batch_size / (layer DP degree * chunks); derived configured batch size, not measured. Consult integral_micro_batch.
galvatron_selected_layers.csv.cp: Fixed to one under the audited native serializer limitation.
galvatron_selected_layers.csv.vocab_zero3: Selected embedding/lmhead sharding flag, propagated to runtime vocab_sdp.

replay_index.json: 32 workload/system/space rows, all preserved attempts and training retries, original stage commands/environment/cwd, source snapshots, logs and configuration hashes. Index only; do not execute recorded output paths in place. Running-stage hashes may be absent.
full_phase_audit.json: Eight full-space paired outcome audits referencing verified successful-training or terminal-failure evidence; no claim of equal full spaces.
oom_incidents.json/csv: Historical actual OOM incidents including repaired profile failures, counted once per workflow not once per rank or diagnostic replay. Possible fragmentation is heuristic, not causal proof.
oom_reporting_policy.json: Primary OOM metric counts selected-configuration formal training only. Profile failures and predicted infeasibility are separate.
allocator_diagnostic_audit.json: Independent evidence audit of original-source allocator-only replays; passing may classify OOM as memory-management sensitive, not proof of exact fragmentation mechanism.
allocator_diagnostic_metrics.csv/json: Only independently verified completed allocator diagnostic training, explicitly labelled allocator and not merged with default-allocator formal results.
